findings.title: Current requirements break the environment checker and contradict the split profiles
findings.evidence: Running C:/Python311/python.exe src/check_environment.py --metadata-only raises ValueError: Unsupported requirement in requirements.txt: seaborn>=0.13,<0.14 before any JSON report is written. The base file also includes SHAP although full/notebook requirements and environment_manifest separate these optional components.
findings.minimum_fix: Restore the eight exact base pins; leave SHAP in requirements-full.txt and seaborn/JupyterLab in requirements-notebooks.txt. Refresh current profile hashes only.

findings.title: Forest training requires optional SHAP package metadata
findings.evidence: prepare() unconditionally calls importlib.metadata.version('shap'). Once the base/full dependency split is restored, a supported base installation cannot execute stage forest even though SHAP is only needed by stage explain.
findings.minimum_fix: Record missing optional SHAP as null; keep required-package failures. Add full-profile preflight before stages all/explain, before lengthy fits.

findings.title: E verification overwrites the submitted historical audit by default
findings.evidence: The documented default python src/verify_e.py --project-root . writes results/audit/e_verification.json. This replaces the supplied historical verification record with the current interpreter's check. verification.py already uses the safe runs/verification default.

findings.title: E verifier mixes reference LR/RF predictions with newly reproduced calibration
findings.evidence: --e-root controls new E outputs and XGBoost only; the loop still reads LR/RF probabilities from project. A fresh all run that differs numerically from historical LR/RF cannot be independently verified using its own complete prediction population.
findings.minimum_fix: Add --prediction-root for LR/RF prediction sources, preserving project as its backward-compatible default. For a fresh complete run pass --e-root RUN --prediction-root RUN.

findings.title: Direct RF explanation invocation can overwrite frozen explanation evidence
findings.evidence: common.OUT defaults to the source project's results directory. Unlike train_rf.py, explain_rf.py has no CLI guard and run() writes SHAP arrays, CSVs, plots and explanation JSON there. run_project routes it safely only when the wrapper is used.
findings.minimum_fix: Reject CLI runs whose output root resolves to the reference project, directing users to run_project.py --stage explain --output-root runs/reproduction.

confirmed_correct: run_project all dispatches AB, Dummy, logistic, forest, explanation, XGBoost, then probability with a shared new output root; reference data remain inputs.
verification.py defaults to runs/verification and does not replace results/audit/integration_verification.json.
reproduce_ab.py retains the single-rounding fix, raw precision exports, training-only caps/scaler/KMeans, outcome-free semantic cluster naming, and readable single-column figures.
Supervised preprocessing is fitted inside each fold. A fixed folds are checked against row IDs.
Strict RF selection uses expanding windows of unique scheduled arrival dates within the earlier training period.
The shared chronological comparison reuses random-CV-selected settings; code metadata correctly discloses this limitation rather than claiming untouched temporal selection.
Threshold/calibration fitting excludes random-test labels. The residual dependence between base OOF models and calibration folds is explicitly documented as a non-nested training diagnostic.
SHAP converts inputs to float32, floors only parsed SHAP thresholds, verifies background routing and class-1 probability reconstruction, and does not mutate the fitted forest.
testing_scope: AST/static code review, real environment-checker failure, B deterministic reproduction, and targeted safe regression checks. Full fresh training is run independently by the parent agent. No claim is made that a run made with the unmodified repository used the later patched source.
